entry.description: Seven of the spectral shape descriptors, computed on a linear scale for both amplitude and frequency.

attributes.name: fftsettings
attributes.digest: FFT Settings
attributes.description: FFT settings consist of three numbers representing the window size, hop size and FFT size in samples: The hop size and fft size can both be set to -1 (and are by default), with slightly different meanings: Constraints For the hop size, -1 = For the FFT size, -1 =snapped to the nearest equal / greater power of 2 (e.g.=>, butalso =>) FFTSize, if != -1, will snap to the next greatest power of two > 4 The maximum FFT size is limited to the value of theargument if FFT size != -1, then window size is clipped at FFT size

attributes.description: Set an explicit upper bound on the FFT size at object instantiation. The default of -1 sets this to whatever the initial FFT size is

attributes.name: maxfreq
attributes.digest: High Frequency Bound
attributes.description: The maximum frequency that the algorithm will consider for computing the spectral shape. Frequencies above will be ignored. The default of -1 goes up to Nyquist. Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: minfreq
attributes.digest: Low Frequency Bound
attributes.description: The minimum frequency that the algorithm will consider for computing the spectral shape. Frequencies below will be ignored. The default of 0 goes down to DC when possible. Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: numchans
attributes.digest: Number of Channels
attributes.description: For multichannel srcBuf, how many channels should be processed.

attributes.name: numframes
attributes.digest: Number of Frames
attributes.description: How many frames should be processed.

attributes.name: padding
attributes.digest: Added Padding
attributes.description: Controls the zero-padding added to either end of the source buffer or segment. Padding ensures all values are analysed. Possible values are:

choices.label: No padding - The first analysis window starts at time 0, and the samples at either end will be tapered by the STFT windowing function.
Half the window size - The first sample is centred in the analysis window ensuring that the start and end of the segment are accounted for in the analysis.

Window size minus the hop size - Mode 2 can be useful when the overlap factor (window size / hop size) is greater than 2, to ensure that the input samples at either end of the segment are covered by the same number of analysis frames as the rest of the analysed material.

attributes.description: The frequency unit for the spectral shapes to be computed upon, and outputted at. The default (0) is in Hertz and computes the moments on a linear spectrum. The alternative is in MIDI note numbers(1), which compute the moments on an exponential spectrum.
